alex: Nightwatch async — quick check-in (SLO/alerts/oncall handoff)

alex: What I did: investigated a burst of retry-related alerts hitting the small-model fleet between 02:15-02:40 UTC. Root cause looks like a transient upstream DNS timeout + aggressive retry backoff not kicking in, which led to short spike in 95p latency and a few pages.

alex: Blockers: still need one more look on the backoff patch — it reduces retry attempts for failed TCP connect errors but I want a second pair of eyes on the test failure in the CI matrix (flaky mock).

alex: Today / next: pushing a small alert debounce tweak to reduce noise (5m -> 8m for the retry-alert), open PR for backoff change, schedule a canary rollout to dedicated clusters at 03:30 UTC. Updated the oncall handoff note with the trace links.

morgan: seeing this now. I'll review the PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/srv-inference/pull/432) — gave initial :eyes: in the diff. The failing test looks like timing-sensitive sleep; I can add a deterministic mock and re-run. Also added a full trace link: https://traces.redwood/inference/trace/abc123 — shows the DNS retry loop.

jamie: I updated the runbook short-term action: when retry-alerts trigger, check `dns-resolution` and `connectivity-retries` dashboards first, then escalate. I also added a quick mitigation step to flip the debounce window and patch the autoscaler policy if we see repeated 95p latency > SLO.

deploy-bot: deployment srv-inference@staging rolled out by alex at 02:58 UTC — status: success :white_check_mark: (build 2026.03.17-58)

alex: thanks @morgan @jamie. I pushed a follow-up commit fixing the mock; CI passed on the second run. Scheduling the canary to run for 30m and will watch `inference.latency.95p` + `retry.rate`. If canary looks good, I'll promote to dedicated pools.

sre-oncall: saw the page, added note in the incident doc about temporary SLA impact for small-models. If canary still shows >SLO after patch, we'll fallback routing to the older model variant for latency-sensitive routes. Also: remind product to expect slight blips this morning (FYI).

morgan: ack — I'll merge the PR once you confirm the canary window. If anything goes sideways ping me and I can rollback the routing via the control plane. :thumbsup:

alex: will do. putting a short watch on this and will post a canary summary in ~35m.
